name: Reconnaissance & OSINT Automation
tagline_zh: 授权渗透前，自动摸清目标底细：子域名、DNS、指纹、OSINT 一网打尽。省下数小时手动侦察，报告直接可用。
tagline_en: Automate recon before authorized pentests: subdomains, DNS, fingerprints, OSINT. Save hours, get report-ready.
desc_en: Passive and active reconnaissance, subdomain enumeration, DNS analysis, technology fingerprinting, and OSINT data correlation for authorized security assessments
why_zh: 不只是跑工具，而是把被动与主动侦察、DNS 分析和 OSINT 关联成一条流水线，输出结构化报告。
why_en: It's not just a tool wrapper—it chains passive/active recon, DNS, and OSINT into one pipeline, outputting a structured report.
